releases.name: Version 1.1.1
releases.body: - Updated text in Ping's ship to list the winners
releases.bodyZh: - ピングの船のテキストを更新して、勝者のリストを表示

releases.name: Version 1.1.0
releases.body:
- Small compatibility update by coderCleric to support the Mod Jam Hub update for jam 5. 
- Adds new dialogue to Ping when that mod is installed.
releases.bodyZh:
- coderClericによる小規模な互換性更新で、jam 5のMod Jam Hub更新をサポート。 
- そのモードがインストールされた際に、Pingに新しい会話を追加。

releases.name: Version 1.0.7
releases.body:
- Added a custom title screen (thanks MegaPiggy)
- Updated some text to say the jam is over (thanks for reminding me Streetlights)
releases.bodyZh:
- カスタムタイトルスクリーンを追加 (thanks MegaPiggy)
- ジャムが終わったことを示すテキストを更新 (thanks for reminding me Streetlights)

releases.name: Version 1.0.6
releases.body: Systems will be closer to the station (8km instead of 12km) if there are 8 or less mods installed. Primarily for jam packs.

releases.name: Version 1.0.5
releases.body: Sun light range fixer will only apply if the light range is bigger than the max (currently 10k)

releases.name: Version 1.0.4
releases.body:
- Changed Central Station glass type to not hide certain effects.
- Adjusted ranges for stars in entries to lessen light bleeding between entries.
- Hardcoded order of entries to avoid overlaps.
- Removed the example platform, moved its props to the center to make room.
- Removed minimaps from platforms (bug that affected Central Station).
- Added space music (thanks Lezzlebit).
- Added ship log map markers for the Central Station and Starship Community.
- Adjusted the model of the Central Station (thanks Streetlights).
- Moved systems and platforms out slightly to make more room.

All entries should now fit in the same system! If this update breaks anything about your entry please fix it and let the judges know, we will use the fixed version of your mod for judging since this breaking wasn't your fault but ours (try to get this done quickly though).

releases.name: Version 1.0.3
releases.body: Added a jetpack refuel spot and a tractor beam to take you to the ship platform.
